skills.name: Iron Body
skills.description: +10% STR mastery.

skills.name: Momentum
skills.description: +3% Body XP for each consecutive day with a completed Body quest, up to +15%. Rest days neither extend nor break the chain.

skills.name: Limit Break
skills.description: One open Body quest rises to the largest target the +10% weekly cap still allows, and pays 3× XP.

skills.name: Light Feet
skills.description: +10% AGI mastery.

skills.name: Second Wind
skills.description: Swap one open Body daily for 15 minutes of mobility. It still counts as the day's Body objective. Not on rest days.

skills.name: Recovery Aura
skills.description: Rest days restore 50% more HP.

skills.name: Unbroken
skills.description: During the day after a missed Daily: it counts as completed at 50% XP, the streak is restored, the 15 HP refunded and the penalty quest removed. Not after a shielded miss.

skills.name: Deep Work
skills.description: +10% INT mastery.

skills.name: Hyperfocus
skills.description: A 90-minute Focus Session linked to one open Mind quest. Finished in full: +90 minutes of progress, 2× its XP and 2× INT mastery.

skills.name: Focus Chain
skills.description: +5% Mind XP for each consecutive day with at least 60 minutes of completed Mind work, up to +25%. Rest days are neutral.

skills.name: Clear Mind
skills.description: +10% FOC mastery.

skills.name: Insight
skills.description: Describe a stuck problem; the app shares it with your status so Claude can split it into 3 sub-quests. Charges per day: 1 + WIS / 20.

skills.name: Literature Sense
skills.description: Paper quests pay full mastery to both INT and WIS.

skills.name: Eigenstate Collapse
skills.description: Pick one open quest or boss task: it pays 3× XP, and the Quests tab shows only it until it is done or the day ends.

skills.name: Restful
skills.description: +10% VIT mastery.

skills.name: Streak Shield
skills.description: The first missed Daily each week keeps your streak and brings no penalty quest. HP rules are unchanged.

skills.name: Bonds
skills.description: Social quests also restore 10 HP.

skills.name: Curious
skills.description: +10% WIS mastery.

skills.name: Clarity
skills.description: A 3-line journal: what moved, what is stuck, tomorrow's one thing. Up to 3 quests for tomorrow from the third line. The text stays on your phone.

skills.name: Mentor's Eye
skills.description: Shares a review request with 28 days of history, so Claude can look at your month and give three recommendations.

skills.name: Equilibrium
skills.description: Completing the rest-day quest fully restores HP and MP and gives +10% XP the next day.

skills.name: Superposition
skills.description: A-rank.

skills.name: Time Dilation
skills.description: A-rank.

skills.name: Singularity
skills.description: Σ.
